source: Kuttler, Linear Algebra: A First Course (2017A), 608 pages, CC BY
about: Hand-written ground truth for retrieval over one real textbook. Every expected section
was read before its question was written, and every negative control was checked to be
absent from the book rather than assumed to be.
expect_section is a path of outline titles, parent first, in the shape section_path takes.
It is a path rather than a title because three of this book's section titles are not
unique: Linear Transformations, Isomorphisms, and The Kernel And Image Of A Linear Map
each appear under two different chapters. A flat section_title cannot tell those apart,
which is most of the argument for the change.
expect_section null means the answer is not in this book at all. Those are controls: KNN
always returns k neighbours, so the measurement there is not whether something came back
but how similar the best thing that came back was.
